Here are 9 things from the last 14 days (around 3 to 17 Oct 2026). A lot of this comes from blogs and second-hand coverage, so check the official page before you build a post on it.

**New tools and features**

1. **Meta Ads AI updates (announced 6 Oct).** Meta is testing an Ads Manager assistant that can build campaigns and change budgets from a chat message. Turning a static image into a video is reportedly live in Advantage+ creative. A tool that leaves out existing customers is also coming, but sources disagree on whether it's live yet. **Why care:** a 1 to 3 person team can get video ads without a video editor, and stop paying to reach people who already bought. **The catch:** the agent part is a test and not in most accounts yet. [MediaPost](https://www.mediapost.com/publications/article/418580/meta-unveils-enhanced-ai-business-assistant-autom.html) · [Common Thread](https://commonthreadco.com/blogs/coachs-corner/metas-new-ai-agent-can-now-run-your-ads-what-the-advertising-week-2026-update-means-for-ecommerce-brands)

2. **Shopify lets shoppers' own AI agents buy from stores (13 to 14 Oct).** Shoppers can connect an AI agent to their Shop account, search over 1 billion product listings and pay with Shop Pay. The buyer still approves each order. Merchants can opt out. **Why care:** AI agents now read your product titles, descriptions and specs. Thin product pages won't get picked. Fits the DESC or STORE tools. [MLQ.ai](https://mlq.ai/news/shopify-lets-shoppers-connect-more-ai-agents-to-its-catalog-and-shop-pay/)

3. **Shopify Canvas: edit your store by chatting with AI (1 Oct, just outside the 14 days).** You type to Sidekick, Shopify's AI assistant, and see the changes live, with no code. One secondary source says it's open to all merchants on standard themes but not on headless (Hydrogen) stores. **Why care:** you can make store changes during the Diwali rush without waiting for a developer. [TechCrunch](https://techcrunch.com/2026/10/01/shopify-debuts-canvas-a-way-to-build-online-stores-by-chatting-with-ai/)

4. **Instagram links in posts and Reels, if you pay (reported 13 Oct).** Clickable links in feed posts and Reels reportedly come with Meta One business plans, starting at the Advanced tier. Plans are listed at $14.99 to $499 a month. **Why care:** this could send Reel viewers straight to a product page. Also, profiles showing AI-generated people without the new "AI-generated profile" label may get less reach. Our clay characters probably aren't affected, but it's worth checking. **The catch:** this comes from third-party blogs only, so confirm with Instagram. [SocialBee](https://socialbee.com/blog/instagram-updates/)

5. **Gemini "skills" rolling out (from 13 Oct).** Saved, reusable tasks in the Gemini app, with full rollout expected by mid-November. Skills for Gmail and Docs (Workspace) are delayed. **Why care:** you could save tasks like "write 5 product descriptions in our tone" once and reuse them. [Parikshit Khanna](https://www.parikshitkhanna.com/post/gemini-updates-indian-business-owners-skills-workspace-october-2026)

**Festivals and sales**

6. **Diwali is Sunday 8 Nov 2026.** Dhanteras is Fri 6 Nov. Bhai Dooj is 10 or 11 Nov depending on the calendar. **Why care:** that leaves about 3 weeks to plan offers, ads and courier cut-off dates. Fits the SALE planner tool. [Diwali.info](https://diwali.info/diwali-dates) · [Samvat](https://samvat.in/festivals/diwali-2026/)

7. **Amazon and Flipkart sales are live.** Amazon Great Indian Festival started 8 Oct. Flipkart Big Billion Days opened 9 Oct, with early access on 8 Oct. Neither has confirmed an end date, though one site guesses around 18 Oct for Flipkart. **Why care:** Meta ad costs and shopper expectations of discounts go up, so plan your own-site offers around this. [Indian Retailer](https://www.indianretailer.com/article/retail-business/retail-trends/festive-sale-2026-flipkart-amazon-myntra-meesho-and-ajio-sale) · [Happy Sellers](https://www.happysellers.in/blog/flipkart-amazon-myntra-sale-2026/)

**Problems people are discussing**

8. **COD returns go up in the festive season.** Unicommerce's report says 58% of COD orders were returned in last year's festive quarter, against under 15% for prepaid. **Why care:** this is the biggest margin leak in the next 3 weeks. Common fixes are a WhatsApp order confirmation, a small prepaid discount and checking addresses before dispatch. Fits the RTO tool. **The catch:** this is one vendor's data, and no 2026 festive figures exist yet. [Unicommerce](https://unicommerce.com/india-d2c-report-2026-april/) · [Amazon Shipping](https://shipping.amazon.in/blog/cod-vs-prepaid-festive-season-surge-india)

9. **New e-commerce rules apply to D2C sites too (notified 9 Sep, so older than 14 days, but people are discussing them now).** Among the changes: a yearly self-check for dark patterns (misleading design tricks), a 48-hour reply time for complaints, and rules on showing "original price" that need 30 days of price history. Reportedly they apply from 1 Jan 2027. **Why care:** if you show strike-through prices, you may need to start logging your price history now. **The catch:** this comes from law-firm blogs, so check the official Gazette. [Legal500](https://www.legal500.com/intelligence/india/consumer-protection/rethinking-e-commerce-compliance-key-changes-under-the-consumer-protection-(e-commerce)-(amendment)-rules-2026) · [Unicommerce](https://unicommerce.com/blog/new-ecommerce-rules-in-india/)

**Left out:**
- **WhatsApp Business:** nothing new in the last 14 days. The latest is the Business AI assistant for India from May 2026, and in-chat UPI payments through it still aren't confirmed live.
- **ChatGPT:** sources disagreed on the checkout timeline. I also dropped virtual try-on as a shopper feature and GPT-6 and Claude Haiku 5.5 as model news.
- **Shopify checkout:** one report said Shopify blocked AI agents from checking out on store websites, which conflicts with item 2.
